# Themes

Color themes for **Mana**. Press **Add to Mana** on a theme and Mana opens to load it.

<ThemeGrid />

## Adding a theme

Add the theme's JSON file to [`docs/public/themes`](https://github.com/Mana-Core/Mana-Core.github.io/tree/main/docs/public/themes). Give it its own `id`: the site won't build if two themes share one.
